result.title: Rotate the Loop: Blockwise Conformality for Looped Transformers
result.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 Workshop "Transitioning from Pre-Training to Post-Training"
result.summary: Looped transformers reuse one shared block across many recurrent steps, so depth becomes a quantity that can be spent at runtime rather than a stack of distinct layers. Those extra steps help only if a write made on one recurrent step is still readable on later ones, and that depends on the linear map applied to the residual between recurrent steps. We show that whether the loop learns to track state is a geometric question about the form of this map, and we propose blockwise conformal injections: the residual splits into coordinate-aligned groups and rotates inside each one, so every group has its own timescale while the geometry stays exact within it. Our experiments show a performance increase on a demanding form of state tracking - last-token accuracy when the rest of the prefix is already correct - and on language modelling, where a signal written earlier has to be retrieved at the end of the sequence.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究 looped transformer 在循环步数上的状态保持能力，指出其取决于循环间残差所经线性映射的形式，并提出分块共形注入：把残差拆成坐标对齐的若干组、在组内做旋转，使每组拥有各自的时间尺度而组内几何保持精确；在末位 token 状态追踪和语言建模任务上报告了性能提升。
AI.relevance_reason: 该文为纯文本工作，但其对循环残差映射几何如何决定跨步「写—读」可行性的分析，可供核查 LVR 中 loop 式 latent 状态更新、深度与长度泛化以及信息坍缩的具体线索。
